subject: 📱 Claude Code folds iPhone Duo layouts; OpenCode cuts memory 25x
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. Sponsor blocks (Google Cloud, MongoDB, Fish Audio) ignored. Quotes are joined across line breaks of the plain-text body.

stories.headline: Liquid AI releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra decision models, priced at $0.02 and $0.042 per 1M input tokens, no output cost
stories.quote: Pricing: $0.02/1M tokens for d1.2, $0.042 for ultra. You only pay for inputs, zero output cost.
stories.description: Decision models returning structured answers from text, images and audio

facts.text: Liquid AI released two decision models, d1.2 and d1.2-ultra, for text, image and audio input
facts.quote: Liquid AI just dropped d1.2 and d1.2-ultra , two models built for one thing: making decisions from any input you throw at them, text, images, or audio.

facts.text: d1.2 costs $0.02 per 1M tokens and d1.2-ultra $0.042; only input tokens are charged
facts.quote: Pricing: $0.02/1M tokens for d1.2, $0.042 for ultra. You only pay for inputs, zero output cost.

facts.text: d1.2-ultra calibration error is stated as 0.8
facts.quote: d1.2-ultra's calibration error is 0.8 , meaning when it says 80%, it's right about 80% of the time.

stories.headline: Claude Code can now run and control the iPhone Duo foldable simulator to test app layouts
stories.quote: Claude Code now runs the iPhone Duo simulator right next to your chat. You describe what you want to test, and Claude folds and unfolds the device itself, checking how your layout holds up at each position.
stories.description: Maker of the Claude Code coding agent

facts.text: Requires macOS with Xcode 27.1 or later and the Xcode plugin
facts.quote: Requires macOS with Xcode 27.1 or later

stories.headline: OpenCode Browse v0.1.0 released as a full Rust rewrite using 25x less memory
stories.quote: OpenCode Browse just dropped v0.1.0, and it's a full rewrite in Rust.
stories.description: Browser tool connecting AI coding agents to a real browser

facts.text: Memory per session fell from about 190 MB to 5.6 MB
facts.quote: 25x less memory used, dropping from ~190 MB down to 5.6 MB per session

facts.text: Binary is now 4.3 MB instead of 53-64 MB
facts.quote: 23x smaller binary , now just 4.3 MB instead of 53-64 MB

stories.headline: OpenAI study finds ChatGPT nearly doubles productivity for 1,800 academic scientists
stories.quote: OpenAI study finds ChatGPT nearly doubles productivity for 1,800 academic scientists

stories.headline: Nvidia releases a free 4GB model that runs fully offline on a laptop
stories.quote: Nvidia drops a free 4GB model that runs fully offline on any laptop
